 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. After being declared as having the least-accessible games on television , watching Cleveland Cavaliers games this season is slightly easier.
 DirecTV subscribers in Ohio will be able to watch Cavs games through a new agreement with DAZN, the team's local broadcast partner.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The agreement covers about 200,000 subscribers and makes games available on DirecTV channel 660.

 Ernest Udeh Jr., center/forward (Emily Faith Morgan, Emily Faith Morgan-Imagn Images) DAZN became the local broadcast partner for the Cavs this season. Previously, viewers who relied on traditional television providers like Spectrum needed a DAZN subscription to watch games that were not nationally televised.
 DAZN costs $19.99 per month, with a $119.99 season pass also available.
 The DAZN broadcasts will be available to DirecTV customers with the Choice package or higher and U-verse TV customers with the U200 package or higher. Coverage will include live pregame, in-game and postgame programming.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cavs games on WOIO Channel 19 or WUAB Channel 43 this season
 Not every game is exclusively on DAZN, however. Fifteen games this season will air on WOIO Channel 19 or WUAB Channel 43,. Those games also will be available at no cost through DAZN.
